name: plonetheme.clara
description: Frontend build for plonetheme.clara. Compiles the single theme bundle theme/scss/clara.scss (Bootstrap 5.3 folded in and driven from --clara-* tokens, the whole @layer cascade, the §7 $spacers remap) into the Plone static resource dir (src/plonetheme/clara/static/clara.min.css) that Clara's registry bundle links into <head>. Run `npm install` to fetch Bootstrap + compile (postinstall runs the build). Bootstrap is pinned EXACTLY to 5.3.8 = Plone 6.2's own (wayfinder ticket 01).
